arStrings.szText: {c_important}Smoke Grenade{/c} no longer {c_important}{u}Dazes{/u}{/c} enemies and instead creates a cloud of shadows at your feet. While within the cloud, you gain {c_number}[{SF_39}*100|+1%|]{/c} Critical Strike Chance and {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c} once every {c_number}[{SF_50}]{/c} second.
{c_important}Smoke Grenade{/c} now deals Poison damage and applies another {c_number}{dot:POISON_DOT}{/c} Poisoning damage over {c_number}{buffduration:POISON_DOT}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Smoke Grenade{/c} no longer {c_important}{u}Dazes{/u}{/c} and deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_PAYLOAD}{/c} Shadow damage. When your {c_important}Smoke Grenade{/c} detonates, it also creates a {c_important}Shade{/c} that leaves behind {c_number}[SF_36]{/c} grenade, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_PAYLOAD_SHADE}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Smoke Grenade{/c} is now also a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill that no longer has a Cooldown and costs {c_resource}[SF_51]{/c} Energy.
Enemies hit by {c_important}Smoke Grenade{/c} become {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_41}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Smoke Grenade{/c} gains {c_number}[{SF_11}*100|+%|]{/c} increased Duration and deals {c_number}[{SF_28}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage.
{c_important}Smoke Grenade{/c} gains {c_number}{SF_46}{/c} Charge or costs {c_number}{SF_43}{/c} less Energy.
